annotations.description: `pve_ha_exporter_last_run_timestamp_seconds` has no sample for at least one of pve1/pve2/pve3 for >5m. Either node-exporter is down, its textfile-collector directory was wiped, or the HA-state exporter has never run on that node. Check `curl -s http://<node>:9100/metrics | grep pve_ha_` on each PVE host. Known-good state: 3 samples (one per node).
annotations.summary: PVE HA-state exporter metric absent on at least one node

annotations.description: HA resource ct:151 (type ct) on node pve1 has state=error for >2m. The LRM has either exhausted max_restart retries (error), the node was fenced, or recovery is wedged. Recovery (PVE 9.x): ha-manager set ct:151 --state disabled (NOT --state stopped — rejected on error-state resources) → diagnose root cause via `ssh pve1 'journalctl -u pve-ha-lrm -n 200'` and /var/log/pve/ha-manager.log.{0,1} → fix underlying issue → ha-manager set ct:151 --state started. Full sequence at runbook_url.
annotations.summary: PVE HA resource ct:151 unhealthy on pve1 (state=error)

annotations.description: This alert is designed to always fire. With the info-severity route (repeat_interval=24h), operator should see one of these roughly once per day on the ntfy-low topic. If this heartbeat stops arriving, Prometheus evaluation, Alertmanager routing, ntfy delivery, or the phone subscription is broken — investigate in that order.
annotations.summary: Alertmanager dead-man's-switch — if you STOP seeing this, the pipeline is broken
